# Remora

> Always-on AI agents you own. Each remora has a spending limit Sui enforces, a memory you can read on Walrus, and a receipt for every decision. Built for the Walrus x Tatum "Total Recall" hackathon (Track 2). Money runs on Sui testnet; memory is on Walrus Memory mainnet; every server-side Sui call goes through Tatum's gRPC.

There are two kinds of remora. A Researcher answers your questions and buys the data it needs from paid services over x402, inside its spending limit. A Wallet watcher watches your wallets and tells you only what matters, learning from rules you teach it in plain words. Nothing a remora reads can make it overspend: the limit is enforced onchain.

## App

- [Home](https://getremora.vercel.app/about): what Remora is, the demo video and the proof
- [Try a Researcher](https://getremora.vercel.app/playground): a $1 spending limit on testnet, no wallet needed, and a paid answer whose receipt verifies
- [Guide](https://getremora.vercel.app/guide): five steps to start, and what every page is for
- [Templates](https://getremora.vercel.app/hatchery): remoras people shared
- [Verify](https://getremora.vercel.app/verify): check any receipt against the chain
- [Status](https://getremora.vercel.app/status): the services Remora depends on, live
- [Telegram](https://t.me/total_recall_remora_bot): /ask your Researcher, /teach your Wallet watcher

## Optional

- [Walrus Memory](https://memory.walrus.xyz): the memory layer Remora is built on
- [Tatum](https://tatum.io): the Sui gRPC gateway every server-side chain call uses
